requirement_evidence.evidence: Recounted raw trace verifying full 5,053 queries, 3,572 supervised queries, 5,034 adjacent within-recording pairs, and 19 recordings. Verified by test_w4_035_c01_denominators_and_strata_recount.

Enforced A_reuse strictly using D_reuse; A_reuse is null when R=0; D_all = D_reuse + D_fallback. Explicit rows retained for unavailable methods M14 and M15 with AUDITED_UNSUPPORTED status. Verified by test_w4_035_c02_agreement_rates_and_null_rule.
Generated all 5 required tables/reports: comparison_matrix.csv, hypotheses.csv, h24_conjunction.csv, summary.md, and statistics.json. Verified by test_w4_035_c03_tables_generation_artifacts.

Handled uncertainty hierarchy over 19 recording clusters without treating overlapping sliding windows as IID or repetitions as seeds. Verified by test_w4_035_c04_c05_uncertainty_and_baselines_reporting.

Reported all 3 baselines (M00 core, M01 wrapper, M16 owned). Classified policy axes (M12, M13) distinct from independent bounding algorithms. Verified by test_w4_035_c04_c05_uncertainty_and_baselines_reporting.

Traced all table cells to underlying execution runs and artifacts. Set missing measurements for unsupported/uninstrumented fields to null/N/A with explicit reasons rather than numeric zero. Verified by test_w4_035_c06_c07_unsupported_status_and_edge_cases.

Tested edge cases including empty strata, disjoint classes, fallback-disagreement isolation from A_reuse, and ratio-of-totals consistency. Verified by test_w4_035_c06_c07_unsupported_status_and_edge_cases.

limitations: Statistical comparisons rely on two-sided paired t-tests clustered across 19 recordings due to temporal correlation between adjacent sliding windows.
External comparator methods M14 (LipCache) and M15 (StreamiNNC/TinyDejaVu) are retained as AUDITED_UNSUPPORTED per W4-029 audit findings.
